title: Chipmakers Race to Cut Power Draw in Data Centers
summary: New accelerators promise the same throughput at half the wattage.

body.text: Further details are expected at a briefing scheduled for later this month.
Officials stressed that the plan will be rolled out gradually to avoid disruption.
Small steps, taken consistently, are how we got here.
Long term, the impact will depend on adoption by the wider industry.
Critics argue the numbers are promising but still need to be confirmed at larger scale.

author.name: Tom Okafor
author.bio: Developer tools and open source reporter.
